cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. For tonight's courtyard film, you fold the moon; I'll switch off the lamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I fold the moon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Start with the crescent. It already has a crease.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the lamps. You handle the sky.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do lamps, chairs and projector if you'll own the moon. Can I tell the audience we're waiting for your blackout?

mechanism: A casts its pupil impossible moon-folding assignment as the next stage of practical training, taking on ordinary tasks to keep the impossible responsibility with B.
confusable: Not requesting help with all work: A bargains away every achievable part while insisting B owns the impossible blackout.
comparison: Outdoor film darkness versus recovering lost time.
